chunks: And he asked him about a man praying while there is garlic or onion in front of him.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while garlic or onion is in front of the worshipper?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the presence of garlic or onion in front of a person does not invalidate or harm the salat (prayer). It indicates permissibility in this specific circumstance within the law of prayer.
